assumptions.calendar: Yahoo official 2026-27 important game dates (https://basketball.fantasysports.yahoo.com/nba/gamedates); opponents from the 12 League Members screenshots
assumptions.fixtures: Known fixtures plus an explicit, seeded representation of the unresolved NBA Cup / TBD team-games (source feed drops them at 80/team); no specific matchups invented. NBA teams fixed to the projection snapshot
assumptions.weeks: 20 league weeks simulated (17 regular + 3 playoff). W1 is 6 days; W7 and W17 are 14-day periods with only 6 and 8 NBA game-days, so period length is not a games-played proxy.
assumptions.injuries: Synthetic Markov episodes calibrated approximately to GP/82; injury share is 75% scaled down for low-MPG role players, remainder isolated rest/role absences. No actual injury diagnosis inferred.
assumptions.il: Three IL slots; medium/long episodes eligible after configurable delay. Returning players require an active-slot opening.
assumptions.waivers: Daily pregame processing; dropped players wait configured calendar days; unsuccessful bids consume no acquisition or budget. Initial waiver order is seeded random, winning bidders move to end for continual rolling tiebreak. Starting FAB/minimum bid are assumptions; old ending balances give only weak spending priors.
assumptions.tiebreaks: Category win percentage, then head-to-head category percentage, then last-period category percentage, then common seeded lottery for regular-season ties. Playoff ties use regular head-to-head category percentage, then higher seed. Verify exact Yahoo fallbacks.
assumptions.streaming: Shared free-agent pool, four adds per scoring period by default (extended 14-day periods keep four unless the optional double cap is enabled), three IL slots, no future-health or box-score oracle. Source Moves totals used only as weak ordinal regular-season activity priors.
assumptions.eligibility: placement (interpretation of eliminated-team locking is unverified)
assumptions.performance: Coherent sampled shooting counts plus shared minute/weekly-form variability; projected points reconstructed from shooting makes due rounding. Not calibrated player covariance.
assumptions.limits: Population restricted to imported projections; missing Yahoo-eligible players cannot be invented. Fixed NBA teams, no fantasy/NBA trades or schedule revisions, no historical role/injury calibration or injury-driven teammate promotions, no speculative injured-FA stash purchases. No calibration of championship frequencies.

uncertainty: Independent source-draft path is the cluster. Worlds paired across policies, distinct across paths. Bootstrap intervals pointwise; bounded simultaneous intervals protect reported comparison family. ±5 percentage-point equivalence requires entire simultaneous interval inside margin. No calibrated odds. Selection on screening/deep data is biased; confirmation is separate.
limitations: Opponent models share a fitted pooled baseline; agreement is not independent validation.
Same-round keeper-cost rule remains unverified; source ownership reconciled.
Hashtag positions are provisional Yahoo eligibility; injury/role projections are a fixed snapshot.
Availability is conditional on modeled opponents and keepers, not calibrated live probabilities.
Small conditional subgroups and boards outside support require the lower-certainty fallback.
The full-board production policy is a diagnostic comparator, not draft-day simulation advice.
